To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• The use of loss differentiation in combination with image coding enables users to reduce the waiting times for web pages, at the expense image fidelity.

(1) a new trade-off between waiting times and image fidelity can be provided, (2) the throughput degradation caused by link-layer round-trip time variability is significant, and (3) loss differentiation can improve performance and fairness, but only when the loss differentiation mechanism is fair.

the performance of the transport layer can be improved through the introduction of a trade-off between waiting times and image fidelity, and that the performance of lossy links can be improved through a loss differentiation mechanism that provides higher layers with loss information that is specific to the link layer.

the development of transport layer techniques that can help to improve user-perceived performance and to increase end-to-end throughput in heterogeneous communication environments.

the performance of communication systems is not only determined by the capabilities of a single component, but rather by the interplay of the various components and protocols in the overall system.
the use of transport layer mechanisms to improve performance can be beneficial, and that the fairness implications should be considered when designing such mechanisms.
